persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalla devasanato gaṇacche pratiṣṭhāyatādayakā va pratiṣṭhā yāṅā dina

notes: The colophon notes that this was the day of consecration (pratiṣṭhā yāṅā dina) established/made by King Jayabhūpatīndra Malla at Gaṇacche (a tole in Bhaktapur).
